honestLimits: Advisory blacklist across guides, not a calendar: no capacity, slots or instant booking.
A creator-wide range cannot overlap another creator-wide range, but it can overlap per-guide ranges (the stricter row wins for requests).
Ranges are still capped at 40 future rows per creator and 61 days per range.
Blocking/removing still sends no email; notices are in-app only.
